description: Na₃V₅O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.46 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.48 Å. There are six inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share edges with four NaO₆ octahedra and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.03 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share edges with three NaO₆ octahedra and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.10 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.11 Å. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.02 Å. In the fifth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-15°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.05 Å. In the sixth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-18°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.13 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with six ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂V₃ square pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂V₃ square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaV₃ trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂V₃ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaV₃ trigonal pyramid, and edges with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaV₃ trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with eight ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with five ONa₂V₃ square pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with eight ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, edges with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaV₃ trigonal pyramid. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three V atoms to form ONa₂V₃ square pyramids that share corners with eight ONa₂V₃ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaV₃ trigonal pyramid, and edges with seven ONa₂V₃ square pyramids.
